blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has revoked the license of the driver involved in a road crash which killed a rider and his 11-month-old child in Quezon City. Based on the initial investigation of the Quezon City Police District (QCPD), the dump truck was traveling toward Luzon Avenue when it tipped over onto a motorcycle traveling alongside it. The accident occurred at around 12:30 a.m. on Oct. 27 along Congressional Avenue corner Luzon Avenue in Barangay Culiat, Quezon City. The truck driver reportedly lost control of the vehicle, crushing the motorcycle carrying a 42-year-old father, his live-in partner […]...
